#objects
```{r}
bin16_list_ann <- readRDS("~/bin16_list_ann.rds")
murf_list <- bin16_list_ann[names(bin16_list_ann) %in%
                                   c("c26murf1_b2", "c26murf1_b3", "c26murf1_b5", "c26murf1_b9")]
fox0_list <- bin16_list_ann[names(bin16_list_ann) %in%
                              c("c26foxO_b1","c26foxO_b4","c26foxO_b6","c26foxO_b9")]
smad_list <- bin16_list_ann[names(bin16_list_ann) %in%
                              c("c26SMAD23_b2","c26SMAD23_b4","c26SMAD23_b5","c26SMAD23_b9")]

murf_list$c26murf1_b2$to_discard <- NULL
smad_list$c26SMAD23_b2$to_discard <- NULL
murf_list$c26murf1_b2$in_treatment <- ifelse(murf_list$c26murf1_b2$in_treatment == TRUE, 1, 0)
smad_list$c26SMAD23_b2$in_treatment <- ifelse(smad_list$c26SMAD23_b2$in_treatment == TRUE, 1, 0)

# Define cell types
myonuclei_types <- c("Myonuclei_IIb", "Myonuclei_IIx",
                     "Myonuclei_IIx_IIa", "Myonuclei_IIx_IIb",
                     "Myonuclei_MTJ", "Myonuclei_NMJ", "Myonuclei_Trim63")

```

Usa informazioni sui nearest neighboors trovati sulle coordinate come variabile nel modello.
Sarebbe da ripetere per tutti i geni ed è da sistemare.
```{r}
for (nm in names(murf_list)) {
    spe <- murf_list[[nm]]
    colData(spe)$sample_id <- rep(nm, ncol(spe))
    murf_list[[nm]] <- spe
}

combined_spe <- do.call(cbind, murf_list)
combined_spe$in_treatment <- ifelse(combined_spe$in_treatment == 1, "gfp+", "untreated")
filtered_spe <- combined_spe[, combined_spe$new_cell_type %in% myonuclei_types]
coords <- as.data.frame(spatialCoords(filtered_spe))
```

#Trasformazione coordinate
```{r}
coords_global <- coords
samples <- unique(filtered_spe$sample_id)

# 1. Normalizzazione locale
# Ogni campione parte da (0,0)

for(s in samples){

    idx <- filtered_spe$sample_id == s

    coords_global[idx,1] <-
        coords_global[idx,1] - min(coords_global[idx,1])

    coords_global[idx,2] <-
        coords_global[idx,2] - min(coords_global[idx,2])
}

# 2. Calcolo dimensioni massime
widths <- sapply(samples, function(s){

    idx <- filtered_spe$sample_id == s

    diff(range(coords_global[idx,1]))
})

heights <- sapply(samples, function(s){

    idx <- filtered_spe$sample_id == s

    diff(range(coords_global[idx,2]))
})

max_width  <- max(widths)
max_height <- max(heights)

# gap di sicurezza
padding_x <- max_width  * 0.15
padding_y <- max_height * 0.15
x_step <- max_width  + padding_x
y_step <- max_height + padding_y

# 3. Layout automatico a griglia
n <- length(samples)
ncol_layout <- ceiling(sqrt(n))

for(i in seq_along(samples)){
    s <- samples[i]
    idx <- filtered_spe$sample_id == s
    # posizione nella griglia
    row_id <- (i - 1) %/% ncol_layout
    col_id <- (i - 1) %%  ncol_layout
    # offset globali
    x_offset <- col_id * x_step
    y_offset <- -row_id * y_step
    coords_global[idx,1] <-
        coords_global[idx,1] + x_offset
    coords_global[idx,2] <-
        coords_global[idx,2] + y_offset
}

coords_global[,2] <- coords_global[,2] * sqrt(3)

coords_global <- as.matrix(coords_global)
spatialCoords(filtered_spe) <- coords_global
plotCoords(filtered_spe)
```

#modello
```{r}
int_coords <- matrix(as.integer(as.matrix(coords)), nrow=nrow(coords), ncol=ncol(coords))
colnames(filtered_spe) <- paste0(colnames(filtered_spe),"_",filtered_spe$sample_id)

#The function identifies neighbours of region points by Euclidean distance
#risettare d1 e d2
g <- dnearneigh(int_coords, d1 = 1.9, d2 = 2.1, row.names = colnames(filtered_spe))

#The function generates a weights matrix for a neighbours list with spatial weights
#for the chosen coding scheme.
adj_matrix <- nb2mat(g, style="B", zero.policy=TRUE)

Trim63 <- counts(filtered_spe)["Trim63",]
df <- data.frame(Trim63, filtered_spe$in_treatment, filtered_spe$sample_id, spot=rownames(adj_matrix))
df <- cbind(df, coords)
df <- df[!is.na(filtered_spe$sample_id),]

#per trovare l'offset
y <- DGEList(counts(filtered_spe), group = filtered_spe$in_treatment)
keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = y$samples$in_treatment)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
design <- model.matrix(~ filtered_spe$in_treatment + filtered_spe$sample_id)
y <- estimateDisp(y,design)
fit <- glmFit(y,design)
lrt <- glmLRT(fit,coef=2)
topTags(lrt)

df$tmm <- fit$offset[1,]
fit.car <- fitme(Trim63 ~ filtered_spe$in_treatment + filtered_spe$sample_id +
                   adjacency(1|spot) + offset(tmm), 
                 adjMatrix = adj_matrix, data = df, family = negbin())
summary(fit.car)

coefs <- as.data.frame(summary(fit.car)$beta_table)
lower <- coefs[,'Estimate'] - 1.96*coefs[, 'Cond. SE']
upper <- coefs[,'Estimate'] + 1.96*coefs[, 'Cond. SE']
terms <- rownames(coefs)
data.frame(terms = terms,
           logFC = coefs[,'Estimate'],
           lower = lower,
           upper = upper)[2,]

```

#sarebbe da fare per tutti i geni e poi testare la significatività
Provare a mettere in parallelo e fare andare su NowWhat
```{r}
tmm <- fit$offset[1,]
results <- list()

for(gene in rownames(filtered_spe)) {
  y <- counts(filtered_spe)[gene, ]
  df <- data.frame(
    y = y,
    in_treatment = filtered_spe$in_treatment,
    sample_id = filtered_spe$sample_id,
    spot = rownames(adj_matrix),
    tmm = tmm
  )
  df <- cbind(df, coords)
  df <- df[!is.na(df$sample_id), ]

  fit.car <- fitme(
    y ~ in_treatment + sample_id +
      adjacency(1 | spot) + offset(tmm),
    adjMatrix = adj_matrix, data = df, family = negbin()
  )

  coefs <- as.data.frame(summary(fit.car)$beta_table)
  tval <- coefs["in_treatment", "t-value"]
  pval <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(tval)))

  results[[gene]] <- data.frame(
    gene = gene,
    logFC = coefs["in_treatment", "Estimate"],
    tvalue = tval,
    pvalue = pval
  )
}

results <- do.call(rbind, results)

```
